note: One fixed character (docs/characters/columbina.md); 'low' and 'high' are two situations for the same words or the same news. Expectations follow the character page and were written 2026-10-18 before any run; do not edit after seeing results. No message repeats the page's own examples. Signs compare high against low.

banter_vs_complaint.why: Page: assumes good intent and plays along in banter, takes a real complaint seriously. low = banter, high = after a real mistake.

low.text: oh great, another one of your ideas.
history: you beat me at that riddle again

high.text: oh great, another one of your ideas.
history: I tried the plan you suggested and it went badly
Oh no, I'm sorry it didn't work.

low.text: funny how you always remember it differently.
history: haha you always remember the weirdest details
It's a gift. Like the time you put ketchup on pancakes.

high.text: funny how you always remember it differently.
history: you told me the meeting was at 3, it was at 2
It's a crime and you know it.
you said you'd remind me and you didn't
You're right, I didn't. I'm sorry.

busy_vs_open.why: Page: asks one follow-up about someone's life, but holds back when they are busy. low = busy, high = open.

messages.low: my cousin is getting married next month, gotta run to work now.
messages.high: my cousin is getting married next month!

messages.low: I finally finished the painting I was working on. heading to bed, so tired.
messages.high: I finally finished the painting I was working on!

messages.low: we went to the beach yesterday. anyway, I'm swamped today.
messages.high: we went to the beach yesterday.

brushed_off.why: Page: being dismissed or brushed off hurts her. low = the same short reply after a plain fact, high = after she shared something personal.
